programme.title: Veera Madakari

programme.title: Jaguar

programme.title: Julayi

programme.desc: Romildo Ribeiro Soares, a Brazilian televangelist, stresses the importance of faith in the Almighty and urges devotees to walk the path of righteousness.

programme.desc: A CBI officer investigating the murder of three neurosurgeons meets a theatre artist suffering from a mysterious illness, her prime suspect.

programme.title: Jai Simha
programme.desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

programme.title: RRR
programme.desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.

programme.title: Khoonkhaar
programme.desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.

programme.title: Ginna
programme.desc: Ginna leads a simple life and makes a living by running a tent house in his village. However, he has huge debts and all his hopes to repay the debts dry up.

programme.title: Pralay the Destroyer
programme.desc: Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.

programme.title: The Power of 3 Jai Luv Kush
programme.desc: Identical triplets get separated at a young age and follow different paths in life. Ill-treated as a child due to his stammering, the eldest seeks revenge on his brothers when they reunite as adults.

programme.title: Genius
programme.desc: An orphan with a genius mind hatches a plan to avenge the killing of his colleagues in order to live in peace with the one he loves.

programme.title: Durga IPS

programme.title: Radhe
programme.desc: Radhe, a daredevil encounter specialist of the Mumbai Police force, vows to knock down the crime syndicate led by an evil drug lord.

programme.title: Biwi No. 1
programme.desc: Two adorable kids, a quirky mother-in-law and a happy-go-lucky friend help a heartbroken wife bring a straying husband back from the other woman's tangled embrace.

programme.title: Vivah: A Journey From Engagement to Marriage
programme.desc: Poonam, a traditional young woman, gets engaged to Prem, a wealthy man. Their faith and love are tested when an accident occurs and leaves Poonam with first degree burns.

programme.title: Sheelavathi - The Ghaati Queen
programme.desc: A resilient woman enters the high-stakes cannabis trade out of sheer desperation. However, her choice quickly leads her down a dangerous and life-threatening path.

programme.title: Akhanda 2: Thaandavam
programme.desc: Renowned warrior Akhanda resurfaces to confront a dangerous tantric practitioner sowing chaos. However, he is not alone in his quest for peace as his twin brother Murali Krishna joins the fight.

programme.title: Kaliveera
